item.title: Deploying Apps to Microk8s on a Raspberry Pi - Part 1
item.description: Introduction Link to heading In this guide we’ll be going through the steps of setting up a Microk8 instance and deploying some applications to it. The aim is to get an better understanding of Kubernetes and figuring out what’s involved in getting applications running. Microk8s is a lightweight version of Kubernetes meant to run on smaller devices such as raspberry pis’. It also comes with addons which allow you to add features as needed.

item.title: Deploying Apps to Microk8s on a Raspberry Pi - Part 2
item.description: FastAPI + VueJS Link to heading In Part 1 of this guide, we setup a Microk8s instance and deployed a rust web application. In part 2, we are going to deploy a web application that has a separate frontend and backend and see how they can communicate with one another. The backend uses the FastAPI framework. The frontend uses the Vuejs. Docker Link to heading Backend Image Link to heading The backend application consists of just 2 endpoints.
